open_graph.og:title: Basic concepts of flexbox - CSS | MDN
open_graph.og:description: The flexible box layout module (usually referred to as flexbox) is a one-dimensional layout model for distributing space between items and includes numerous alignment capabilities. This article gives an outline of the main features of flexbox, which we will explore in more detail in the rest of these guides.
